Name: TetrisPlugin
Description: Full-feel Tetris: SRS wall kicks, 7-bag, lock delay, hold, ghost and DAS/ARR.
LongDescription: A 10x20 well with the pieces players expect: SRS rotation tables for JLSTZ and I, a 7-bag randomizer, 500 ms lock delay with move resets, hold-once-per-piece, a ghost piece and a three-deep next queue. The model is a plain class with no QObject and is covered by tests; the page runs a 16 ms frame loop and owns the DAS/ARR repeat, because Qt's key auto-repeat is both slower and less controllable than a hand-rolled one. Leaving the page does not pause, so pausing first is the way out.
